1.א: One who cooks does not need to wait bdei sheyeasu (OC 318:1).

2.ב: Whether the animal fell ill today—permitted… we do not say muktzeh because we hold R. Shimon on muktzeh midissura unless discarded by hand and unfit like figs—here not discarded; attached fruit unlike muktzeh bein ha-shmashot because anyone could gather—animal requiring expert shechitah and checked knife is not “discarded” by not slaughtering—Beit Yosef.
2.ג: Without salting—forbidden to salt on Shabbat—Tosafot Shabbat end Kelal Gadol.
2.ד: Lest he increase for him—after placing pot on fire he might add pieces for the healthy person—that is skila (Torah); before placing only rabbinic issur—Rashba.

3.ה: But in sun—no normal cooking this way; sun and fire are not confused—Ran.
3.ו: So it roasts—lest bury in ash or make a hole.

4.ז: “R. Abahu’s chicken”—Shabbat Kirah and Ḥavit ch. 8 45a; Rashi: soaked many days in hot water for medicinal eating; Ran 113b: very salty and soaked in hot water when needed.

5.ח: Forbidden to place bread… Rema’s practice is lechatchilah to forbid.
5.ט: Gemara’s first version—even if we don’t rule that way, since one opinion says salt “cooks” in keli sheni, salt differs; perhaps all agree about bread—Maharshal; see inner sources.

6.י: But if something hot is inside—even if it could cook, since not intended and see Maggid Mishneh.

16.יב: Permitted; Sefer HaMitzvot permitted; all the more a pot with gravy where fat congealed—not “ba’ein” when melted—permitted accordingly; practice stringent like Ra’ash; in need one may rely on leniency.
